image_description: A low-angle shot of a stylized, curved street sign assembly against a deep blue sky. The structure consists of a dark arched top bar and a lower, elongated oval sign panel. Both elements feature white lettering that appears distorted and illegible, resembling gibberish or melted text. There are red graphical accents on the upper arch. The signs are mounted on a vertical pole visible on the right side.
